metadata.title: FastFill: Efficient Compatible Model Update
metadata.doi_status: No conference DOI established from accessible primary sources; do not invent one.
metadata.pages_status: No proceedings page range supplied by the official repository; the arXiv PDF has 24 pages, which is document length rather than proceedings pagination.

sources.verified_fact: Live official authors' repository identifies FastFill as ICLR 2023 and provides matching author order, title, venue, year and inproceedings type in its citation block (lines 144-148).
Official Apple page confirms authors, title, March 2023 and ICLR; its abstract identifies feature alignment, partial backfilling and uncertainty estimation.
Primary arXiv record confirms v1 submission date, author order, title, ICLR comment and arXiv-issued DOI.

Primary full text: introduction p. 2 explicitly describes initial deterioration under earlier losses plus random ordering (Figure 2a); pp. 5-6 describe predicted-uncertainty ordering and partial gallery replacement.
sources.access: Live web open succeeded on 2026-11-01; 24-page PDF.

uses.reason: Both clauses are supported. Visual alignment and uncertainty-ordered partial backfilling are explicit. The initial-decline claim is existential ('can'): p. 2 identifies FCT-Random in Figure 2a as a case where performance falls before improving. This does not assert that FastFill itself necessarily declines or that every replacement policy does.
